_readme: Public changelog (pages/changelog.html and /.netlify/functions/changelog). Every entry says what changed and where it came from. Member feedback is never quoted and members are never named; when the owner closes a member's feedback with a public note, that note is added automatically. Newest first.

entries.title: Look inside every IP, and one record across The IV Phases™
entries.text: Every product in The .LLab Products™ now has a Look inside preview before purchase: what it is, where it sits in The IV Phases™, its sections, two sample prompts, what you walk away with and whether it is included with The .LLab Membership™ or a separate purchase. In the Member Portal, the mission, vision, purpose, values and legacy statement you already wrote are offered back in the next IP that asks for them; retaking a quest keeps a summary of the earlier run so you can see what moved; and your path shows the next step in each phase. Reports and the portal label what you entered apart from the analysis generated from it.

entries.title: The IV Phases™ in every guided IP
entries.text: Every guided quest now carries all four phases (Foundations, Infrastructure Planning & Management, Internal Operating Systems and Preservation), with new prompts written for each IP, clearer questions where a prompt was only a label, and a four-phase build guide: the deliverable of each phase and how to put it to work. Long quests offer a short path as well as the full path.

entries.title: Phase Readiness, your Legacy Statement and commitment check-ins
entries.text: Your portal now totals every finished quest into one Phase Readiness view, drafts one Legacy Statement from your own answers (yours to edit, private, and downloadable as a PDF), and brings each quest commitment back at 30, 90 and 365 days so you can record what happened.

entries.title: Team mode and the Team Quest Facilitator Guide
entries.text: Several leaders can now work the same quest, each in their own account, and see where their answers differ. Answers are shared with the team only after a person accepts, and stop being shared when they leave. A one-page facilitator guide shows how to run a quest with a team.

entries.title: Nonprofit and Small Enterprise editions of the Diagnostic
entries.text: The same Diagnostic in the language of a nonprofit (board, staff, volunteers, donors) and of a small enterprise (an owner, a small team, cash flow). Owning the Diagnostic unlocks both editions.

entries.title: A free Succession quest
entries.text: A free quest for every signed-in member: what must stay true when leadership changes, who carries each role, how the handover is practiced, and where the succession record lives.

entries.title: The .LLab Collaborating Enterprises: introductions, offers and more ways to find each other
entries.text: Filter by all nine directions of the Omnidirectional Enterprise™. Request an introduction to an enterprise that welcomes them (their email stays private). Listings can carry a member offer, join the Nonprofit & Community category with skill and volunteer requests, and flag that they are seeking a successor or an apprentice.
